welcome.title: How did we do?
welcome.description:
We're the {team} at {company}. You contacted us recently, and your answers help us decide what to fix first in how we support you.
• Takes about 3 minutes
• Anonymous: answers aren't linked to your support ticket
• Voluntary: you can stop at any time
• Open until {date}. Questions? {contact}

thank_you.title: Thank you for the feedback
thank_you.description: Every answer is read by the {team}. We review results every month and share what we changed on our help centre. Questions? {contact}
